summary: Phase 35 — Claros Launch (Career & Placement Intelligence) end-to-end testing. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases PASS covering all 14 /api/v1/launch/* endpoints (companies/drives/eligible/apply/applications/skills CRUD/skill-gaps/interview question+evaluate+history/readiness-score/admin stats) + authorisation (non-student blocked from apply/skills/interview/readiness 403; student blocked from /stats 403; VCE principal blocked from cross-tenant ISB 403) + idempotency (apply twice returns same row) + multi-tenant (VCE+ISB have 15 companies + 8 drives; EAIC/UoB have 15 companies + 0 drives by design) + regression (legacy /api/alumni/{iid}/directory + /api/placements/{iid}/summary + Phase 32 /v1/core/stats + Phase 33 /v1/enroll/leads + Phase 34 /v1/comply/dashboard). Frontend (Playwright): /launch dashboard renders readiness ring (67) + 4-tile breakdown (cgpa cell present) + 3 cards (drives/apps/gaps). /launch/drives renders 4 tabs (UPCOMING/ONGOING/COMPLETED/ALL); UPCOMING shows 5 cards with 5 Apply buttons; clicking Apply showed 'Applied to Accenture' toast. /launch/skills renders 8 seeded skills grouped (PROGRAMMING/TECHNICAL/TOOL/SOFT); 'Analyse Gaps' triggered Claude → AI gaps panel with 5 gap cards (HIGH:System Design~12w, HIGH:DSA~16w, HIGH:OOP~6w, MEDIUM:AWS~8w, MEDIUM:C++~10w). /launch/interview full flow: Get Question generated a bracket-validation TECHNICAL question → submitted DP-based answer → Claude feedback rendered with score 2/10 (real critique), strengths bullet, 6 improvement bullets, and 8-item history list. /launch/admin (principal) renders 4 KPI tiles (placed=9, placement%=45%, avg=₹4L, max=₹4.25L) + top recruiters horizontal bars (Wipro/Cognizant/HCL, 3 each).

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent — was returning 500 because insert_one mutates doc with non-serialisable ObjectId _id; added doc.pop('_id', None) before return.

issues: Recharts emits console warnings 'width(-1)/height(-1)' on first render — chart still draws bars correctly after layout settles. Cosmetic; consider wrapping in ResponsiveContainer with explicit minHeight.

action_items: [OPTIONAL] Wrap admin top-recruiters chart in a sized ResponsiveContainer to silence Recharts width/height(-1) console warnings.

[NICE-TO-HAVE] The Claude interview evaluator returned a 2/10 because the seeded TECHNICAL question on bracket validation didn't match the DP-based answer — this is correct AI behaviour, not a bug. Confirm product expectation that mismatched answers should score low.

_coerce_iid is invoked with c['tenant_id'] (already a string) inside get_company — works but slightly confusing; usually iid arg is meant to be the *requested* param.
skill_gaps prompt does not include the student's program code, only program name — could be more targeted.
No pagination on /companies (limit 200) or /drives (limit 200) — fine for current scale but flag for future.

rca_of_issue_fixed: POST /api/v1/launch/drives/{id}/apply returned 500 with TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable. Root cause: motor's insert_one mutates the input dict by adding the BSON _id field; the route returned this mutated dict, and FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialise ObjectId. Reproduction: any student POST /apply (fresh, not idempotent path). Mitigation: doc.pop('_id', None) immediately after insert_one — applied in /app/backend/routes_launch.py line ~154.
